title: Progress Series (VisualElements)

scenarios.title: Progress Series applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Progress Series (BtnProgressSeries) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Progress Series state codec defaults and lenient partial parse are pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The persistent state codec round-trips every field (count, active index, mode, layout, highlight color, shape type); partial tags overwrite only the present fields over the documented defaults, unparsable integers fall to zero like the historical TryParse, and foreign tags are rejected with defaults intact.

scenarios.title: Progress Series creates a series the production recognizer accepts in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Progress Series default command on an empty slide creates at least one new shape and the production IsProgressSeries recognizes the created element (measured seriesRecognized=True), reports execution, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.
